text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy got injured during training.
Her treatment in the infirmary has finished, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ah, Trainer...!
Just now, um... i-it was nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I'll do whatever training it takes,
so please let me come back...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I just keep resting like this, I feel like
the gap between me and the others will only widen...!
choice_data_list: Strict rest until the pain subsides.
...I'll try to think of a way.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... so you did notice the pain...
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...At times like this, a hero wouldn't get
discouraged—they'd keep moving forward, right?
I want to be like that, too..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But... pushing myself is bad, right?
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest...

Zenno Rob Roy held back her impatience
and quietly rested up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much, Trainer!
I'll be in your care...!

"I decided to have her do some light movement first as a test.
I told her that if it caused any pain,
we would stop immediately."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I only moved it a tiny bit...
She was made to give up on training and rest quietly...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it doesn't hurt.
I should be able to make my comeback like this...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I won't overdo it, so please, let me do the next workout routine...!
Afterward, Zenno Rob Roy tackled a training routine designed with her injury in mind!
